newsitem.title: ST VINCENT AND THE GRENADINES: CARIBBEAN BANANA VENTURE MAKES PROFIT IN FIRST YR.
newsitem.headline: CARIBBEAN BANANA VENTURE MAKES PROFIT IN FIRST YR.

text.p: The joint venture that bought the Geest Banana business last year has made a 9.15 million Stg (US$14.36 million) profit in its first year of operations, a company official said.

Arnhim Eustace, who represents Windward Islands Banana Developing and Exporting Co (WIBDECO) on the board of WIBDECO/Fyffes, said the board had recommended a 4.0 million Stg (US$6.28 million) return to shareholders, reported Caribbean News Agency (CANA).

"There are many who thought it was inadvisable for the industry to become involved in this venture but the company in its first year of operation has performed above expectations despite many difficulties," he told a marketing seminar.

WIBDECO is jointly owned by the governments and banana associations of Grenada, St. Lucia, Dominica and St. Vincent. It bought Geest last year for 150 million Stg (US$23.55 million) in a 50-50 partnership with Irish fruit company Fyffes.
